messages:
From: Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@acme-corp.com>

Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 09 May 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial ask and audit period clarification

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting procurement for an integration and need Redwood’s most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or a bridge letter if the report period won’t cover our window). A couple of specifics from our side: 

- Audit window: we need coverage that includes 2027-11-01 through 2028-04-30 (our compliance team will accept either a full Type II covering that window or a Type II report that ends earlier plus a bridge letter that confirms controls remained in effect through 2028-04-30).
- Minimal package: SOC 2 report PDF, bridge letter (if applicable), and an asset/inventory checklist that maps major control owners.
- Transfer: secure S3 presigned or SFTP preferred; if easier, a DocuSign/Share link works.

Can you confirm what you can provide, estimated delivery, and any small template replies our procurement folks can copy back into the RFI? Also, do you have any evidence artifacts you commonly include (e.g., policy snapshots, configuration screenshots)? If you have a one-page intake checklist, please attach.

Thanks — Tim

--
Tim Jenkins
Senior Security Analyst, Acme Corporation
security@acme-corp.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 May 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial ask and audit period clarification

Hi Tim — thanks for the clear note. Short answers up front: yes, we can help and we have two practical options depending on what you need quickly vs. what you need for your procurement binder. Details below and I’ve attached a short intake/checklist and a bridge-letter sample.

What we can provide (minimal & recommended):
- Minimal deliverable (fast): current SOC 2 Type II report PDF (covers 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31) + bridge letter signed by our security lead confirming controls remained in effect through 2028-04-30.
- Full deliverable (recommended for audits): SOC 2 Type II PDF + supporting artifact index (policy snapshots and select telemetry samples) + signed bridge letter + contact for control-owner clarifications.

Common artifacts we include on intake:
- Policy snapshots (Access control, Change mgmt, Incident response)
- Diagram of logical architecture (redacted)
- Sample configuration screenshots (e.g., logging/retention settings)
- A short artifact index (we don’t provide raw logs unless contractually requested)

Secure transfer options:
- Prefer: S3 presigned link (short TTL) or SFTP inbound to your host
- Alternate: secure share link (Redwood Share) + password, or HubSpot secure file transfer for legal docs

Estimated timing:
- If you take the minimal path (report + bridge letter): 3 business days after you approve the transfer method and sign an NDA (we’ll provide a brief mutual NDA if needed).
- Full package: 7-10 business days to assemble the artifact index and get signatures.

One-line reply templates (copy/paste for procurement) — pick the one that fits:
1) Minimal: “Please send Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter (covers through 2028-04-30). Preferred transfer: S3 presigned link.”
2) Full: “Please provide Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report, signed bridge letter, and artifact index/policy snapshots. We prefer S3 presigned or SFTP transfer.”
3) NDA-first: “We need a short mutual NDA before receiving the report. Please provide the NDA and preferred secure transfer method.”

Attachments included: redwood-bridge-letter-sample.pdf (one-page), redwood-intake-checklist.pdf (one-page). I’ve also included an internal filename we use to track intake, ACME_SOC2_ask_sheet.xlsx — please fill any fields you can to speed the full package if you plan to request the full deliverable.

If you want, Rishi can be the control-owner contact for access & change management questions. Monica will coordinate delivery & signatures.

Next steps: reply with preferred transfer method and whether you want minimal vs. full.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Security & Compliance (Customer Programs)
Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: redwood-bridge-letter-sample.pdf (attachment stub), redwood-intake-checklist.pdf (attachment stub), ACME_SOC2_ask_sheet.xlsx (attachment stub)

Vanessa — thanks for the fast turnaround and the templates. We’ll take the minimal path to start.

- Transfer: S3 presigned (short TTL) is preferred.

- Delivery target: could you send by EOD Monday (2028-05-13)? That would align with our procurement deadline.

Also looping in Carol (cc) from procurement — she’ll confirm transfer details (S3 bucket and TTL preferences). We’ll fill the ACME_SOC2_ask_sheet.xlsx and return if more detail is needed.

Thanks again — Tim
